checks.name: Original Pi edit proposes disjoint replacements, original diff and patch with zero filesystem effect
Pi preserves UTF8 BOM and CRLF bytes on edit and exact undo
Original SDK fuzzy Unicode matching is retained and its actual result is reviewed
Pi rejects ambiguous, overlapping and no-change edits without a ledger entry or write
Reject is durable, cannot execute, and keeps exact source
Call identity and revision CAS refuse duplicates with different input and stale approvals
Cross-session review, decision and apply cannot read or commit another session change
Source changes before approval or after approval become conflict without overwriting teacher edits
Concurrent same-revision decisions and file commits cannot approve or install twice
Original Pi write only captures a new artifact until approval, exclusive installation and undo remove that artifact
A competing new target refuses approval without overwriting it or creating parent directories
Undo conflict preserves a subsequent manual modification exactly
Stop, cancellation and workspace revocation refuse approved effects
Traversal, credentials, Windows path aliases, device names, unsupported formats and hardlinks are rejected
Ancestor junctions and target replacement by a link fail closed before commit
Invalid UTF8, NUL, oversized text and invalid nested inputs never reach disk
Recovery invalidates pending/approved intents idempotently and never writes files
Ledger hash corruption and unknown schema fail closed before file effect
Real child exits after intent/file and undo-intent/undo-file are classified by read-only verification without replay
Old real isolated database copy migrates through production session-state without changing prior business/history facts

boundary: Real Pi0.80.3 tools/diff, SQLite, local files and child-process exits. No provider, UI/IPC, production tool registration or full P07-A claim.
